title: Zeta clan spammer
script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Target Controller",
   LoadingTitle = "Loading System...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by Vort Clan",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false }
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Auto Sender", 4483362458)

-- Default Variables
local targetName = "CELEST"
local delayTime = 0.8
local isRunning = false

-- Stylish @=@= Repeating Block
local stylishBlock = string.rep("@=@=", 18)

-- Dynamic Word Bank (All Capital Words)
local wordsList = {
    "DIAMOND", "COSMIC", "WAVE", "TATTI", "ROSE", "RICE", "TORNADO",
    "BLOOD", "SUGAR", "MANGO", "RAINBOW", "SNAKE", "CLOWN", "OMEGA",
    "CYBORG", "PHANTOM", "VIPER", "TITAN", "SHADOW", "BLADE", "STORM",
    "DRAGON", "VENOM", "THUNDER", "NOVA", "HYPER", "INFERNO", "GALAXY",
    "STARLIGHT", "METEOR", "BLAZE", "COMET", "ECLIPSE", "VORTEX", "NEBULA",
    "SOLARIS", "PYRO", "FROST", "GLACIER", "SPECTRE", "QUANTUM"
}

-- Chat Service Handle
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local function sendChatMessage(msg)
    if ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents") then
        ReplicatedStorage.DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(msg, "All")
    elseif TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.TargetTextChannel then
        TextChatService.ChatInputBarConfiguration.TargetTextChannel:SendAsync(msg)
    end
end

-- Helper to get next 7 DIFFERENT ALL CAPS words for each new line
local function getNextSevenWords(startIndex)
    local selectedWords = {}
    local totalWords = #wordsList
    
    for i = 0, 6 do
        local currentIndex = ((startIndex + i - 1) % totalWords) + 1
        table.insert(selectedWords, string.upper(wordsList[currentIndex]))
    end
    
    return table.concat(selectedWords, " ")
end

-- UI Controls
Tab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Target Name",
   PlaceholderText = "CELEST",
   RemoveTextOnFocus = false,
   Callback = function(Text)
      if Text ~= "" then targetName = string.upper(Text) end
   end,
})

Tab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Custom Delay (Seconds)",
   PlaceholderText = "0.8",
   RemoveTextOnFocus = false,
   Callback = function(Text)
      local num = tonumber(Text)
      if num then
         delayTime = num
      end
   end,
})

Tab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Start Sender",
   CurrentValue = false,
   Flag = "SenderToggle",
   Callback = function(Value)
      isRunning = Value
      
      if isRunning then
         task.spawn(function()
            local wordCounter = 1
            
            while isRunning do
               local sevenWords = getNextSevenWords(wordCounter)
               
               -- Output format: @=@=@=@=@=... CELEST TMX MARE [7 CAPITAL WORDS]
               local formattedMessage = stylishBlock .. " " .. targetName .. " TMX MARE " .. sevenWords
               
               sendChatMessage(formattedMessage)
               
               -- Shift forward 7 words for next line
               wordCounter = wordCounter + 7
               
               task.wait(delayTime)
            end
         end)
      end
   end,
})
